category: inference endpoint, keyless, one auto-selected model

free_tier.stated: No account and no API key. Per IP address: 60 requests per minute, 20,000 requests per day, 10,000,000 tokens per day, at most 65,536 input tokens and 8,192 output tokens per request
free_tier.notes: the service chooses the model on every request; GET /v1/models lists one id, auto, and a requested model is ignored

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client; POST {base}/chat/completions with no Authorization header, or with Bearer flm_anonymous for SDKs that insist on a key. GET /limits returns the live limits as JSON and is not counted
chaining: pairs with an agent loop that sets max_tokens; the model cannot be pinned, and the service picks one per request

limits.value: 60 requests per minute per IP address (rolling 60-second window); over the limit the service answers 429 rate_limit_exceeded with a retry-after header
20,000 requests per day and 10,000,000 tokens per day per IP address, both reset at 00:00 UTC; 65,536 input tokens and 8,192 output tokens per request

binding_note: the 60 requests per minute per IP address binds before the 20,000 per day

identity_cost.detail: none: the guide lists Authentication as None; omit the Authorization header or send Bearer flm_anonymous, and any other key is rejected with 401

reliability_note: under load the service answers 429 rate_limited after making a request wait up to 8s for capacity, and 502 upstream_error when an answer fails mid-way; identical temperature-0 requests may be served from a short-lived cache
confidence_note: the limits, the model list and the x-ratelimit headers were read by GET; no chat completion was sent, because probe issues GET and HEAD only, so whether a completion answers is unverified
